claims.text: The classification threshold ($\phi$) is derived empirically based on the precision-recall curve and is set at values such as 0.76 and 0.67 for classifying claims as 'SUPPORTS'.
A threshold of $\phi = 0.76$ requires at least 3 out of 4 questions to be answered correctly for a claim to be classified as 'SUPPORTS'.
A threshold of $\phi = 0.67$ requires at least 2 out of 3 questions to be answered correctly for the same classification.
